title: Penalty entries are counted twice in participant result totals
problem: my_results adds each penalty amount to penalties and also adds the same row to by_component, then computes total as sum(by_component.values()) + penalties. Negative penalties therefore reduce the returned total twice.
impact: Any penalized team receives a displayed score that is lower than the ledger total by exactly the penalty amount.

verification.basis: Current source inspection at the main-branch commit listed in metadata. Original audit line numbers are treated as historical and were not reused as current line references.

implementation_steps.action: When iterating ledger rows, add kind == penalty only to the penalties accumulator; do not include penalty rows in by_component, or alternatively compute total from the ledger once and expose the penalty subtotal separately.
Define sign convention explicitly: penalties should be stored as negative values and total should be the sum of all ledger entries once.
Add fixtures for zero penalty, one penalty, multiple penalties, positive bonus and adjustments; assert total == SQL SUM(points) for the team/stage.

acceptance_criteria: The response total equals the authoritative ledger SUM exactly, including penalty cases.
The by_component breakdown plus separately reported penalties reconciles without double counting.
regression_tests: Add a focused failing test before implementation where practical.
Add a negative authorization / boundary test, not only a happy-path test.
Run the affected backend/frontend suite and the full CI workflow before merge.
